meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 它会判断你的 Git 请求类型（提交、变基、查历史、看状态），先读取仓库现状，再按你明确要求执行提交或改写历史；仅调查的请求只报告证据，不擅自改动。产出提交哈希、消息和剩余未提交文件清单。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交或调查 Git 历史时触发；普通代码编辑会跳过。

say.text: 把这些改动拆成原子提交，保留无关的未暂存内容。
say.note: 它会按行为分组并逐个提交。

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁在哪个提交改的。
say.note: 它会用 blame 并给出提交哈希和行号。

say.text: 用 bisect 找出第一个坏提交，好版本 abc，坏版本 def。
say.note: 需要确定性的通过/失败命令。

howto.what_en: It classifies your Git request (commit, rebase, history, status), reads repo state, then only performs commits or history rewrites you explicitly asked for; investigative requests get evidence only. It reports hashes, messages, and uncommitted files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; ordinary code edits are skipped.

say_en.text: Split these changes into atomic commits, keeping unrelated staged work out.
say_en.note: It groups by behavior and verifies each commit.

say_en.text: Find who last changed this line and in which commit.
say_en.note: It uses blame and cites the hash and line.

say_en.text: Use bisect to find the first bad commit; good abc, bad def.
